claims: Artemis II successfully launched on April 1, 2026.
Artemis II launched at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
Artemis II launched from NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis II crew is on a journey around the Moon and back.
Artemis II marks the first crewed Moon mission since 1972.
The launch vehicle for Artemis II is the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The mission goal of Artemis II is a ~10-day crewed flyby of the Moon to test systems for future moon landings.
Artemis III is a crewed lunar landing.
Artemis III is targeted for mid-2027.
